_comment: Hand-written stand-in for the CCR record (plan.md phase 0). Content is slide 4 of 'Radiant Capabilities Overview.pptx' verbatim, except where noted in docs/content-model.md. Emphasis is carried as <strong>; the renderer decides how each field's emphasis is treated. This file stays in the repo after the CCR exists so the renderer remains testable with no Drupal running. Six pillars, because the business has six — the website lists all of them and no shipped slide template holds more than five, which is what channel-side selection is for (renderer/lib/select.js). `key` is how a deck names an item; in the CCR it is the paragraph's uuid, here a readable slug.
